name: Do I need a lawyer if the police report states the other driver was at fault?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a lawyer if the police report states the other driver was at fault?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even if the police report clearly assigns fault, hiring a lawyer is highly recommended. While the report is strong evidence, insurance companies often dispute liability or the extent of damages. A lawyer can effectively counter these tactics, gather additional evidence to strengthen your case, and negotiate a fair settlement that fully compensates your family for all losses. Without legal representation, you risk receiving less compensation than you are entitled to or having your claim undervalued.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, even with a favorable police report, a lawyer can help ensure you receive fair compensation and handle insurance company disputes.
